rubric: A pure refactor: the existing checks pass and nothing is different to look at, text_only.

criteria.format: CI/CD, config, infrastructure or a pure refactor: nothing a person could watch or run to see it

reading.why: A refactor with no behaviour change leaves nothing different to look at.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: video
ruledOut.why: A pure refactor. It is not: a UI or flow change a person should watch happen, and the browser run ran on a running system: scenarios the browser drove, a recording or replayable steps, and the video image is there.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: screenshots_or_terminal
ruledOut.why: A pure refactor. It is not: an API or CLI change: screenshots when there is something to see, else a terminal capture of the commands and the scenarios' tests.
